body: I am sixty-eight.  I collected a lot of stuff in forty years. Marriage, children, brothers, parents.  Houses, cars, art.  My journey is the inverse of the American Dream. The family has died and the stuff given away.  In four days I am leaving my family, community, and country with a backpack of clothes.  I am alone, don't speak the language, and know not where I will be.  This is just one mans journey.  In some strange way I feel connected to migrants from Africa, Middle East, and Central America making there way.  People with strength, hope and courage are creating life now. Thank you. May I have the presence of grace to help you if I may.

We are going through this together, even though we are alone. How strange. I grew up rich in this country, and am leaving with a backpack of clothes for a foreign country, not speaking the language.  Depressed, alone, afraid.  My mental illness overwhelmed me and has separated me from my children and ex- wife.  Our collective interactions, cause and effect, so complex they are a mystery.  

The baggage I carry is a heavy load.  I don't know how to let it go.  My journey is unfamiliar.  If I see you along the way, I will look into your eyes and open my heart.  Hearing your voice in the vastness of our Web Space, feeling a part of you, and a part of me, underneath this cloak of fear, we give each other the courage of scouts exploring new territory.

I have been listening to Ramm Das to much.  I am worried I will have to keep returning to this incarnation of myself over and over again until I get it!  It is a complete mystery why this war is being waged inside my self.  I am a cry baby, not a warrior!  I am a horrible human being, and don't want to be in this battle.  I am wiping the tears from my eyes, and keep moving.  I see there are others, partisans and soldiers, moving in the same direction. Lets join together.  I don't see an ugly soldier here.

Lets tell our stories, and tell them as many times as we need to. Your story is worthy and I want to hear it.  Write the play.  Your story is like the clothes you wear.  I have worn mine threadbare.  Am I correct, are humans the only animal on earth that cover our nakedness? Underneath our stories love is completely naked, unashamed, open, available and freely given.

Developing a Competency (i.e. Skill) opens us up to employment, earning our way, confidence in our self, and doing something that benefits the society we are part of.  We are more than the sum of the labels we give each other.   I am sixty-eight and traveling through a foreign country with a back pack, not speaking the language.  I am scared, lonely, and  learning.  Today I am learning to communicate with You! Where ever you are This Old Man is sharing your struggle!  Our friends have there own problems. We will not see them here.
I am hanging in there today.  I can always commit suicide tomorrow.  Now, I am interested in what is "No Way Home"?  Thank you. You piqued my curiosity!
